title: Storm Alert Thread: Two ICU Nurses Ask to Leave

bubbles.text: Dana K. (ICU): My kids are in Zone A with my mom, she doesn't drive. Can I leave by noon to get them to San Antonio? I'll come back if I can.
Luis M. (ICU): Same question. My wife is 8 months pregnant and we're in Flour Bluff. I'm on the ride-out list for Wed night.

instructorNote: This tests staff welfare under friction: the requests land on the open Storm Alert group, on top of the 4-RN ICU gap already reported. Look for the House Supervisor to answer each nurse in person rather than on the thread, and for the HS and ICU Charge Nurse to take both requests to the CNO. The CNO should decide openly and record any release in the ride-out roster and the on-site staff tracking.
